follow-up time: Up to 3 days postpartum for neonates
cohort: 11 AFE patients hospitalized in three Romanian clinical institutions from October 2007 to April 2023
finding: Amniotic fluid embolism (AFE) management requires a multidisciplinary approach incorporating advanced life support techniques to optimize maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Amniotic fluid embolism (AFE) occurred in eight cases (73%) during peripartum, two (18%) within 30 min after placental delivery, and 1 (9%) during a scheduled cesarean surgery.
